tours.name: Review the Payroll Analysis
tours.description: Learn how to read the payroll analysis, filter it by period and group the amounts, for example by salary rule or department.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to read the payroll analysis, filter it by period and group the amounts, for example by salary rule or department.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: The payroll reports are in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: The payroll reports are in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Reporting menu
steps.description: The Reporting menu of the Payroll app holds its analysis screens. They only read data, so you can explore them safely.

description_i18n.en_US: The Reporting menu of the Payroll app holds its analysis screens. They only read data, so you can explore them safely.

steps.title: Payroll
steps.description: This report totals the payslip lines: gross, deductions and net pay over time.

description_i18n.en_US: This report totals the payslip lines: gross, deductions and net pay over time.

steps.title: Search options
steps.content: Click here to open the search options.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the search options.

steps.description: Filters and groupings are in this menu. They change what you see, not the data itself.

description_i18n.en_US: Filters and groupings are in this menu. They change what you see, not the data itself.

steps.title: Pick a filter
steps.content: Click a filter to narrow the figures.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a filter to narrow the figures.

steps.description: A filter keeps only the records that match, for example a period or a status. Click it again to remove it.

description_i18n.en_US: A filter keeps only the records that match, for example a period or a status. Click it again to remove it.

steps.title: Group the figures
steps.content: Click a grouping to split the figures.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a grouping to split the figures.

steps.description: Grouping splits the figures by employee, type, department or period. Several groupings can be combined.

description_i18n.en_US: Grouping splits the figures by employee, type, department or period. Several groupings can be combined.

steps.title: Change the view
steps.content: Click Pivot to see the same figures as a pivot.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Pivot to see the same figures as a pivot.

steps.description: The pivot table lets you compare salary rules, departments and months side by side.

description_i18n.en_US: The pivot table lets you compare salary rules, departments and months side by side.
